content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the TISS Assistant Manager-Operations Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of TISS to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

content_sections.heading: TISS Assistant Manager-Operations Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for TISS Assistant Manager-Operations Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for filling online applications for the Assistant Manager-Operations post at TISS is 05 October 2026. Candidates are advised to complete their applications well before the deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for Assistant Manager-Operations at TISS?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy announced for the Assistant Manager-Operations post in the Tata Institute of Social Sciences (TISS) Recruitment 2026. This is a contractual position based in Mumbai, Maharashtra.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for TISS Assistant Manager-Operations?
faq.answer: The application fee for General/OBC candidates is Rs 500/-, for SC/ST candidates it is Rs 125/-, and Women candidates are exempted from paying any application fee. Fees must be paid online.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary for the Assistant Manager-Operations position at TISS?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Assistant Manager-Operations post at TISS will receive a salary ranging from INR 45,000 to 50,000 per month. This is a competitive salary for a contractual role in a government institution.

faq.question: Q5. What are the essential qualifications for Assistant Manager-Operations?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Post Graduate/Master's Degree in a relevant field and possess a minimum of 5 years of experience in Client Account Management (Operations Profile). Experience in the Tourism & Hospitality Sector is preferred.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for Assistant Manager-Operations at TISS?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Assistant Manager-Operations position at TISS primarily involves an Interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their applications and called for an interview to assess their suitability for the role.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for the TISS Assistant Manager-Operations post?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online through the official website of TISS (www.tiss.edu) or by using the direct apply link provided in the Important Links section of the notification. Ensure all details are filled correctly and documents uploaded.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the job location for the Assistant Manager-Operations post?
faq.answer: The job location for the Assistant Manager-Operations position at Tata Institute of Social Sciences is Mumbai, Maharashtra. This offers an opportunity to work in a prominent educational institution in a major metropolitan city.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, the Assistant Manager-Operations position at TISS is a Contractual job type. While TISS is a government institution, this specific role is offered on a contract basis, providing valuable experience in the sector.

faq.question: Q10. When was the official notification for this recruitment released?
faq.answer: The official notification for the TISS Assistant Manager-Operations Recruitment 2026 was released on 18 September 2026. Candidates should refer to this notification for all detailed information and instructions regarding the application process.
